articles.summary: GOTHENBURG, Sweden --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 9, 2026-- Polestar’s (Nasdaq: PSNY) retail sales in the first half of 2026 amounted to a record estimated 30,423 cars. In the second quarter, retail sales were an estimated 17,296 cars. This press release features multimedia.
articles.title: Polestar retail sales reach a record 30,423 cars in the first half of 2026
